Bose Quiet Comfort Earbuds – Premium In-Ear Noise Cancelling Earbuds

Bose Quiet Comfort Earbuds deliver world-class audio performance with advanced adjustable noise cancelling technology. Designed for users who demand premium sound, superior comfort, and reliable performance, these in-ear earbuds combine cutting-edge acoustic engineering with a sleek, ergonomic design. Whether you’re commuting, working, traveling, or working out, these wireless noise cancelling earbuds create a focused listening experience every time.

With Headphone Fit: In Ear, the earbuds provide a secure and comfortable seal that enhances bass response and blocks unwanted external sounds. The soft silicone tips adapt naturally to your ears, ensuring long-lasting comfort even during extended listening sessions. If you are searching for the best in-ear noise cancelling earbuds with a comfortable fit, this model offers an ideal balance of stability and performance.

Advanced Adjustable Noise Cancelling Technology

Experience immersive audio with Noise Cancelling: Yes and Noise Control Type: Adjustable Noise Cancelling. Easily customize your listening level by controlling how much outside sound you want to hear. Whether you need complete isolation on a flight or awareness during a walk, the adjustable noise cancellation system adapts to your environment.

These premium wireless use advanced acoustic technology to deliver clear highs, deep bass, and balanced mids. The combination of in-ear sealing and active noise cancellation makes them ideal for music, podcasts, calls, and streaming.

Built-in Microphone for Crystal Clear Calls

Featuring Microphones: Built-in Microphone, these ensure clear voice pickup for calls and virtual meetings. The integrated microphone system filters background noise, allowing your voice to come through naturally. Whether you’re attending online meetings or taking calls on the go, you get consistent clarity and reliability.

Durable & Water Resistant Design – IPX4 Rated

With Water Resistant: IPX4, the Bose Quiet Comfort are built to withstand sweat and light splashes. This makes them suitable for workouts, light rain, and everyday active use. The durable construction combines Plastic (PC-ABS), Silicone, and Metal to ensure longevity while maintaining a lightweight feel.

Compact, Portable & Rechargeable

Designed for portability, the earbuds are compact and easy to carry:

  • Bud Single: 2.8 x 2.5 x 2.1 cm (0.39 lb)
  • Case: 3.5 x 7.01 x 4.82 cm (0.104 lb)
  • Entire Product System: 11.09 x 8.3 x 5.6 cm (0.395 lb)

The lightweight charging case fits easily into your pocket or bag, making it perfect for travel. With Rechargeable: Yes, you can power up quickly and enjoy extended listening time. The rechargeable battery ensures consistent performance without frequent replacements.

Why Choose?

  • Premium in-ear wireless with secure fit
  • Adjustable noise cancelling for personalized sound control
  • Built-in microphone for clear hands-free calls
  • IPX4 water resistant for workouts and daily use
  • Compact charging case with rechargeable battery
  • Durable materials: PC-ABS plastic, silicone, and metal
  • Lightweight and travel-friendly design

If you are looking for high-performance wireless noise cancelling with superior comfort and sound quality, offer a premium listening solution. From immersive music sessions to important work calls, these deliver consistent performance with advanced noise control and ergonomic in-ear comfort.
